notes: A surface is a client through which a person reaches Agent OS.
Entries are provider-neutral descriptions only. Probing logic lives in src/agent_os/surfaces.py and path resolution in src/agent_os/machine.py.
Locations are machine-independent: '~' for the user home, '${VAR}' for an environment variable, 'repo/' for a path inside this repository.

surfaces.name: Claude Code
surfaces.summary: Terminal coding agent that calls Agent OS directly over MCP and is preflighted by the user-scoped instruction file.

surfaces.name: Claude Desktop
surfaces.summary: Desktop client that can register the same MCP server; it has no user-scoped instruction file, so preflight must be carried by the server instructions.

surfaces.name: Codex CLI
surfaces.summary: Coding agent preflighted by the installed AGENTS.md adapter and able to call Agent OS over its MCP server registration.

surfaces.name: ChatGPT (regular chat)
surfaces.summary: No automatic invocation path. The routing skill is the thinnest bridge: the chat states its findings and they are captured locally through the CLI.

invocation.reason: the host cannot start a local stdio server

surfaces.name: ChatGPT Work project
surfaces.summary: Work projects can carry the routing instructions as project text, but still cannot invoke Agent OS; captures return through the CLI.

invocation.reason: the host cannot start a local stdio server

surfaces.name: Any other MCP-compatible client
surfaces.summary: Server-side readiness for clients that are not registered individually. Reaching 'routed' requires that client to also carry a preflight instruction.

instruction.reason: no user-scoped instruction file is known for an unidentified client
